title: Pairs Grinder — 50 Min Cap
body:
Round 1 (3 Rounds):
500m Row/Ski or 1000m Bike
40 Wall Balls
30 Burpees
40 KB Swings (16/24kg)
30 Box Jump Overs

Round 2 (3 Rounds):
20 DB Thrusters (Alternating)
40 Reverse Lunges (DB)
20 Devil Press (Alternating)
400m Run (Synchro)

Buy-Out:
80/100 Cal Echo, Ski or Row
100 Sit-Ups

title: Synchro Lap Ladder — E5M
body:
2000m Row
2000m Ski
4000m Bike

Lap 1 (Every 5 Min):
30 DB Snatch
10 Synchro Burpees

Lap 2 (Every 5 Min):
20 Box Jump Overs
20 Synchro Sit-Ups

Lap 3 (Every 5 Min):
30 Wall Balls
20 Synchro Squats

Lap 4 (Every 5 Min):
20/24 Cal Echo

Back to lap 1 and so on until all ergs are completed.
